newsitem.title: USA: Zoltek names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Zoltek names chief financial officer.

text.p: Zoltek Cos Inc said it named Daniel Greenwell as chief financial officer, replacing William Downey who resigned from the company to pursue other business interests.
In a statement issued late Thursday, Zoltek said Greenwell, 34, had been corporate director of financial analysis and reporting at Sigma-Aldrich Corp.
Zoltek is an applied technology and materials company that is focused primarily on low-cost manufacturing and application of carbon fibers used as a reinforcement material in composites.
Its Hungarian subsidiary makes and markets acrylic fibers, nylon products and industrial materials.
